# Remora

> Remora: one inbox in your menu bar or tray for code reviews, Slack, Linear, Jira, Notion and Microsoft 365, sorted by what you have to do. On-device.

Remora is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0-or-later) macOS menu bar app. It groups items by what you have to do
(To reply, To review, To fix, Ready to merge, To do, Reminders, To read, Waiting on others), runs its sorting and
ranking on the device, and only talks to the tools the user or their organization allows: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Slack, Linear, Jira, Notion and Microsoft 365. A tray
app for Windows and Linux is in preview. French pages: https://triage.iscor.me/fr/.

## Pages

- [Remora — One inbox for GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Slack, Linear, Jira, Notion and Microsoft 365](https://triage.iscor.me/en/): Code reviews, Slack, Linear, Jira, Notion and Microsoft 365 in one inbox in your menu bar or tray, sorted by what to do. Free, open source, no account.
- [Features — Remora, the menu bar inbox for developers](https://triage.iscor.me/en/features): Verbs instead of apps, Done and Pin, snooze with a reason, reminders, review prep and sessions, a waiting assistant. All of Remora.
- [Privacy & compliance — Remora sends nothing but to your tools](https://triage.iscor.me/en/privacy): No server, no account, no telemetry: Remora talks only to the tools you allow, with AI off by default and a policy IT can lock with MDM. Every data flow.
- [Press kit — Remora, the menu bar inbox for developers](https://triage.iscor.me/en/press): Descriptions in one line, 30 and 100 words, the logo, the app icon, screenshots and the facts about Remora, free to use.
